purpose: Shared orbital sensitivity for supported waves and the shared-stellar-mass benchmark
interpretation: Tangential, isotropic and radial preferences using known constant-beta Jeans dynamics; not measured priors
mass_parameters: Retain frozen wave m and source fraction, and the previously frozen common ordinary-mass multiplier
samples: Training and already-exposed validation; no further parameter selection or fresh validation claim
comparison: Use the same beta choices for each hypothesis; light bending is unchanged because mass profiles stay fixed
limitations: Sensitivity test, not simultaneous mass/orbit posterior inference, stellar anisotropy measurement or source stability proof
